defects.title: Every call fails because fdTable.mat is not shipped
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) error MATLAB:load:couldNotReadFile "Unable to find file or directory 'fdTable.mat'." at line 20
defects.expected: the diet with its food amounts scaled to the calories target

notes: Reproduction: normalizeDiet({'167512', 100}, 2000, {}) -> "Unable to find file or directory 'fdTable.mat'." (line 20). No fdTable.mat in the repository (git ls-files, find); getDietEnergy, getDietComposition and getMetaboliteFlux note that the fdTable functionality was removed (2024). Even with fdTable restored, normalizeDiet calls getDietEnergy(foodMenu) with the default databaseType 'usda', so fdTable food names would not be USDA IDs: the function needs a rewrite, not a data file. No src caller of normalizeDiet. makeDietFormatConsistant.m (line 21) and nutritionAlgorithmWBM.m (line 260) also use fdTable and will hit the same missing file.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: line 20 loads fdTable.mat, which is not in the repository)

reason: needs the Python package pyarrow (with pyarrow.flight) in MATLAB's Python, which the reference machine lacks; the class cannot even be loaded without it, and most methods also need a running Arrow Flight server (network)
notes: Probe (R2025a, 2026-11-15): pyenv = system python3 3.12; COBRArrow.pyarrowLib -> MATLAB:Python:PyException "Invalid default value for property 'pyarrowLib' in class 'COBRArrow': Python Error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyarrow'". The Constant properties import pyarrow and pyarrow.flight when the class is first used, so every line (including the static conversion methods MatFieldToPyArrow / pyArrowTableToMatField that need no server) is unreachable here. If pyarrow is installed later (initCobrarrow pip-installs src/base/cobrarrow/requirements.txt, which needs the internet), a Tier 1 test could cover the static converters (round trip of char, numeric, cell, sparse matrix fields) and the constructor/requireAuthentication error without a server (FlightClient connects lazily); login/send/fetch/optimize stay network exemptions. Not tested further, no test file created.

defects.title: An empty git listing returns the folder itself as a file
defects.trigger: empty git repository d (git init); getFilesInDir('dirToList', d, 'type', 'tracked'); likewise 'untracked' with no untracked files, 'all' in an empty repository
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) tracked -> {[d '/']} (1 element); all -> two copies of [d '/']; strsplit(strtrim(''), '\n') gives {''} which is prefixed with the folder path

defects.title: The default checkSubFolders omits subfolders in folders not under git
defects.trigger: folder d outside git with a.txt and sub/b.txt; getFilesInDir('dirToList', d)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) {[d '/sub'], [d '/a.txt']}: default '' is false at line 102 so rdir('*') lists only the top level; with checkSubFolders = true sub/b.txt is listed; in a git repository the same default lists subfolder files

defects.title: Folders are listed as files in folders not under git
defects.expected: only files, as in a git repository

notes: Reproduction (run in MATLAB, uses git, no network): d = tempname; mkdir(d); mkdir(fullfile(d, 'sub')); fclose(fopen(fullfile(d, 'a.txt'), 'w')); fclose(fopen(fullfile(d, 'sub', 'b.txt'), 'w')); getFilesInDir('dirToList', d) -> {d/sub, d/a.txt}; getFilesInDir('dirToList', d, 'checkSubFolders', true) -> {d/sub, d/a.txt, d/sub/b.txt}. e = tempname; mkdir(e); system(['cd ' e ' && git init -q .']); getFilesInDir('dirToList', e, 'type', 'tracked') -> {[e '/']}; 'all' -> {[e '/'], [e '/']}. Everything else probed behaved as documented: git tracked/untracked/ignored (printLevel 1 prints the repo root), 'all' = tracked + untracked incl. ignored, checkSubFolders false filters paths with filesep, restrictToPattern, ignoredByCOBRA (non-git and git without COBRA remote: files matching the COBRA .gitignore patterns; with a remote containing cobratoolbox.git it switches to 'ignored'). A full test (all branches reachable with git init in tempname + 'git remote add origin <url>', no network) is straightforward once fixed; note the persistent COBRAIgnored (line 47-50) needs 'clear getFilesInDir' to cover line 50. Quarantine reach, for the lead: callers changeCobraSolver (type ignoredByCOBRA, checkSubFolders false: defect 1 is filtered out by the pattern match, defects 2/3 need a non-git or empty listing - ignoredByCOBRA on a non-git folder keeps folders matching patterns) and removeTempFiles (type/checkSubFolders from its arguments); test/testAll*.m also call it. Defect 1 is confined to calls without checkSubFolders on non-git folders; defect 2 is not recognisable from the call form.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: outside git the listing comes from rdir('**/*'), lines 107 and 129, which includes folders; the writer reproduced the empty-git-listing and default-subfolder defects in MATLAB)
